metadata.author: Ceilidh-jo Rowe
metadata.description: From the creator… Beautiful acoustic music loved by children and their adults alike.  Little IMP Songs is a collection of childrens songs, rhymes and lullabies, created for Inclusive Musical Play and to nuture an early love of music and singing. The collection also helps support confidence, expression, speech development, and even maths skills! Ceilidh-jo’s music has long been a staple for many families in the car on trips, at home playing and at bedtime.   Here’s a lovely review - “I have found no other [children’s music] that even comes close to this wonderful collection. The music has it’s roots in history but speaks to our 21st century kids. It charms my 2 young kids into blissful contentment as they are transported to a magical land. I would recommend this album for all families”
